summary: Iteration 222 — Airport Transfer (P2) end-to-end validation. Backend 6/6 pytest green (3 from existing test_airport_transfer.py + 3 new in test_iter222_airport_extras.py covering AF1006 cancelled, flight-refresh 200 on airport ride, 400 on non-airport ride). Frontend admin /admin/airport page renders perfectly with all 4 KPIs, both tabs, working reservations list (8+ existing bookings displayed) and airport create form (TEST FE Airport created, toast 'Aéroport créé', persists in list). Client /course?mode=airport renders the full airport panel — all 9 expected testids present, luggage toggle reveals stepper, shuttle toggle works, '45 min offertes' note shows. API ride creation for the fresh client returns ride with flight_status.status='delayed' for AF1002 plus adjusted_pickup, luggage_fee=5, shuttle_discount>0, meeting_point + free_wait_minutes=45 populated, and the scheduled ride is listed on /scheduled-rides. The only real issue: FlightWatchBanner is NOT rendered while ride.status==='pending' (RideTrackingPage.js:666 early-returns the searching UI before reaching the banner at line 920). The 'airport-kpi-cancelled' testid mismatch is non-existent — the component correctly uses 'airport-kpi-cancelled_flights' matching the counts key.

ui_bugs.issue: When an airport ride is still pending (driver search), the page early-returns the searching UI and the FlightWatchBanner (data-testid='flight-watch-banner') is never mounted. Clients booking an airport transfer cannot see flight number, terminal or status while waiting for a driver.

issues: Card for an airport reservation shows 'Airport · Sb' but does not surface flight number / terminal / flight_status. Nice-to-have to differentiate airport bookings.

action_items: Render FlightWatchBanner (or a compact variant) inside the pending/searching early-return block of RideTrackingPage.js (~line 685-755) when ride.ride_type==='airport', so airport clients see flight info immediately after booking.
[Optional] Add flight number + terminal + status badge to the /scheduled-rides card when ride_type==='airport'.
critical_code_review_comments: core/airport.simulate_flight_status is deterministic (seed = hash of flight_number) — AF1002 reliably returns 'delayed' with adjusted_pickup, AF1006 returns 'cancelled'. ✅
POST /api/phase2/rides/{id}/flight-refresh correctly returns 200 with flight_status for airport rides and 400 for non-airport rides. ✅

Admin reservations dashboard counts {active, completed, delayed, cancelled_flights} are accurate; the 4th KPI key is 'cancelled_flights' (review request listed 'cancelled' — implementation aligns to the backend counts shape).
RideChoosePage airport panel exposes 9 stable data-testids covering all UI states (select, flight input, terminal, arrival, luggage toggle/stepper, shuttle toggle, free-wait note). ✅
AdminAirport.js create form correctly persists a new airport via POST /api/phase2/config/airport-zones, displays a success toast and refreshes the list. ✅
Gap: FlightWatchBanner is gated behind the non-pending render path; the pending early-return path lacks the banner — see action item above.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (admin page + client panel + booking via API all green; FlightWatchBanner not shown while pending)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Airport Transfer backend + admin UI + client booking panel are fully wired. Only remaining UI gap is mounting FlightWatchBanner inside the pending (driver-search) state on /ride/:id. The /scheduled-rides card could optionally be enriched with flight info. Status simulation is deterministic per flight_number — when testing, prefer AF1002 (delayed+adjusted_pickup) and AF1006 (cancelled).
rca of the issue: RideTrackingPage.js executes a full early-return at line 666 `if (ride.status === 'pending')` that renders a dedicated radar/searching layout — this code path never reaches the main body where <FlightWatchBanner ride={ride} /> is mounted (line 920). Fix: also render FlightWatchBanner inside the pending return (above or below the bottom 'ride-searching' sheet) gated on ride.ride_type==='airport'.
